bills.title: Northern Australia Infrastructure Facility Amendment (Extension and Other Measures) Bill 2021

name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-05-13.74.1) introduced by South Australian Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston) (Liberal), which means it was successful. The amendment added the words below to the [original motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-05-13.25.1), which was agreed to earlier this day. ### Amendment text > *That the order of the Senate agreed to earlier today relating to the consideration of legislation be varied as follows:* > > *At the end of subparagraph (a)(v), add:* > >> *(E) [Northern Australia Infrastructure Facility Amendment (Extension and Other Measures) Bill 2021](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6670);* ### Original motion > *That today:* > > *(a) the routine of business from 11.45 am be as follows:* > >> *(i) notices of motion;* >> >> *(ii) consideration of a report from the Standing Committee for Selection of Bills;* >> >> *(iii) placing of business;* >> >> *(iv) formal motions; and* >> >> *(v) consideration of the following bills:* >>> >>> *(A) Migration Amendment (Clarifying International Obligations for Removal) Bill 2021 and Migration Amendment (Tabling Notice of Certain Character Decisions) Bill 2021,* >>> >>> *(B) Education Legislation Amendment (2021 Measures No. 1) Bill 2021,* >>> >>> *(C) Health Insurance Amendment (Prescribed Fees) Bill 2021, and* >>> >>> *(D) Social Services and Other Legislation Amendment (Student Assistance and Other Measures) Bill 2021;* > > *(b) if by 1.30 pm consideration of the bills has not concluded, the questions on all remaining stages be put without debate;* > > *(c) paragraph (b) operate as a limitation of debate under standing order 142; and* > > *(d) following consideration of the bills, the Senate return to its routine of business.*
